## 3. Required development-host synchronization

First prove you are in the correct repository:

```bash

```

The remote must resolve to `zzkkoo8/xmg-qa2`.

Then execute the user-authorized reset:

```bash
git fetch origin --prune
git switch feature/003-support-foundation || git switch -c feature/003-support-foundation --track origin/feature/003-support-foundation
```

Existing stash entries and old local branches are considered abandoned history. Do not apply/cherry-pick them into this Feature.

## 6. Implementation authority

Allowed:

- project-local dependency installation;
- repository code/config/tests required by T001-T013;
- Docker/Compose development services;
- development/test migrations and data;
- Fake external providers used by deterministic tests;
- Git commits/pushes to `feature/003-support-foundation`;
- opening/updating the Feature PR.

Not allowed:

- direct development on `main`;
- merge to `main` without user instruction;
- production deployment;
- customer production write/restart/install/delete/shell actions;
- arbitrary remote shell capabilities;
- committing real credentials/tokens;
- silently replacing core architecture component families;
- claiming real Dify/model/DingTalk acceptance from Fake tests.

## 7. Stop and escalate only for real blockers

Stop the affected task and report evidence if:

- a core component family is incompatible and must be replaced;
- lease/checkpoint/business reconciliation cannot satisfy the tested invariants;
- implementation conflicts with a Critical/High design requirement;
- required host permissions cannot be obtained without modifying shared infrastructure outside this project;
- implementation would weaken the customer-target READ_ONLY policy.

Ordinary build/test failures are debugging work, not reasons to redesign the project.

## 8. Per-task reporting

After every task return/record:

```text
Task:
Files changed:
Tests/commands run:
Result:
Commit SHA:
Known risks/blockers:
Next task:
```

Never report a task complete without actual verification output.

## 9. Feature completion boundary

Finishing T001-T013 means the **support-foundation Feature** is implemented and verified. It does not mean xmg-qa2 V1 is production-ready.

Still required in later V1 Features:

- real Dify Knowledge integration and quality baseline;
- real model integration/quality evaluation;
- real DingTalk channel;
- real authorized read-only API/MCP capability;
- full Chat/Admin/product configuration surface;
- online/offline release acceptance and target-environment recovery testing.
